verdicts.label: B
verdicts.evidence: The perimeter of a diamond-shaped flood growing one unit per turn is 8n + 4. For a large initial flood of radius R, the perimeter at turn n is 8(R+n) + 4. Sun Wukong can build a barrier of length gamma * n. As n goes to infinity, the ratio (8(R+n) + 4) / n approaches 8. Thus, for any gamma > 8, Sun Wukong can eventually enclose the flood by choosing a sufficiently large n. If gamma <= 8, the Sea God can choose a large enough initial flood to prevent Sun Wukong from winning.
